correctness.rationale: The star cover gives an equivariant homotopy suspension because line-star intersections are stabilizer-equivariantly contractible and the nerve is a full fixed-point simplex. The projective-plane pairwise line intersection axiom makes the linewise relative star collapses globally compatible, leaving a regular cyclic cover of a q-rose. A difference-set pair with difference one yields a split integral group-ring boundary (t-1,0,...,0). The finite independent integral quotient chain and exact projective-plane enumerations pass; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: For every prime power the quotient is explicitly a q-sphere wedge, and the full integer Singer second-homology lattice is Z plus q-1 regular group-ring summands. The geometric spine and cyclic module explain the absence of orbit torsion rather than merely reporting Betti numbers. The projective plane incidence/nonincidence duality is a natural testbed for symmetry-sensitive topological invariants.
